title: Jasper Appoints Alex Rindels as CEO to Lead Next Phase of Applied AI for Enterprise Marketing
summary: Appointment builds on Jasper’s enterprise momentum and deepening of its forward-deployed AI model
body_markdown:
[Jasper](https://www.jasper.ai/) , an applied AI company for enterprise marketing, today announced the appointment of[Alex Rindels](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexrindels/) as Chief Executive Officer. Rindels, who has been with Jasper for four years and most recently served as Vice President of Business Operations and General Counsel, will lead the company as it sharpens its focus on helping enterprises turn AI investment into measurable business outcomes.


Rindels joined Jasper in 2022 as the company’s first lawyer, and has taken on progressively broader leadership responsibilities as the business has evolved. Over the last year, he became a central operator at Jasper, working across sales, marketing, product, finance and engineering to turn strategy into execution company-wide.


“Enterprise AI is entering a new phase, where the companies that win will be those that can translate the technology into real, repeatable business outcomes,” said Jeff Horing, co-founder and Managing Director at Insight Partners. “Alex has been part of Jasper’s evolution for the past four years and understands the company, its customers and the opportunity ahead. He brings the operating focus and deep knowledge of the business to lead Jasper through its next phase.”


Under Rindels’ leadership, Jasper will continue to deepen its work with enterprises putting AI into practice. The company combines forward-deployed expertise, Jasper IQ and purpose-built agents to identify, execute and measure the marketing work that matters most. Earlier this month, Jasper[announced](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/jasper-expands-forward-deployed-model-pairing-marketers-with-engineers-to-turn-enterprise-ai-into-business-outcomes-302934152.html) an expansion of its forward-deployed model following a year in which the company nearly doubled its enterprise annual recurring revenue.


Rindels’ appointment is part of a broader evolution of Jasper’s leadership team. The company has also promoted[Guhan Venguswamy](https://www.linkedin.com/in/guhan-venguswamy-5b154b14/) to Chief Strategy Officer and[Christian Freitas](https://www.linkedin.com/in/christianfreitas-jasper) to Chief Revenue Officer. The moves build on the[promotion](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/jasper-strengthens-executive-leadership-for-the-next-era-of-enterprise-marketing-302840597.html) of Tom Newton to Chief Marketing Officer and appointment of Lauren Newman as Chief Financial Officer earlier this year.


Rindels succeeds Timothy Young, who has accepted a new role and will leave Jasper on November 27 after three years as CEO. During his tenure, Young helped lead Jasper's evolution from one of the first generative AI platforms toward its focus on serving enterprise customers.


“Jasper has been an AI company since before most people were talking about AI at work,” said Rindels. “Over the past four years we’ve evolved alongside the market and our customers, and I look forward to leading the company as we continue to execute against our commitment to partner with enterprise marketers to build on-brand, governed agents that deliver measurable business outcomes.”
